rca of the issue: Badge raw-HTML bug (dashboard/alerts): previous implementation used e(badge($alert['type'])) which HTML-escaped the HTML tags emitted by badge(), producing literal '<span class=...>' visible to the user. Fix: emit badge() output directly (already applied and verified). Personnel dup-NRP missing flash: presumably the modal form posts to personnel.php which forwards to /api/personnel POST via includes/api.php; on 409 the controller likely stores an error but redirects without persisting the flash to the session, or the modal-close JS reloads before the flash renders. Main agent should trace the POST handler in personnel.php.
